A positive pipe is dollars arriving on the venue, sell-side supply, and a negative pipe is dollars leaving, measured as the 24-hour change in holdings excluding each exchange's own token. Binance sent out 793.0 million dollars, up from 427.4 million dollars, Bybit sent out 90.3 million dollars, and Crypto.com sent out 34.1 million dollars, while Bitfinex took in 39.5 million dollars.
